title: Prayer for the Removal of Difficulties

blocks.x: Twentieth: Shaykh al-Kulayni, in his book entitled Ta’bir al-Ru’ya, has reported on the authority of al-Washsha’ who reported Imam alRida (‘a) as saying: In my sleep, I saw my father saying to me: Son, whenever you are in a trouble, repeat this saying as many times as possible:
Imam al-Rida (‘a) then commented, “There is not any difference between what we (i.e. the Holy Infallibles) see in waking and what we see in sleep.”
